title: GOAL Phase F: Jev in production — one round trip per gated call, block rule without confidence, daemon posts Codex results, first measurements
spec: User 2026-09-19 (session restart): keep going with the Jev tasks. Follow-ups from the Phase E approving review T-0239 and the gotchas: the gate hook does two uv round trips per tool call; every noul answer so far carried confidence null so gate_mode=block can never fire; the daemon's Codex dispatch path never posts results so Codex-executed tasks stall in running; per-worker gate scores are not yet observed. Branch goal/T-0240 from goal/T-0201 (PR 9 base). Merge order stays 6, 7, 8, 9, then this goal's PR. Measurement targets after F1-F3 merge: runs/jev/gate.jsonl rows per worker run, median gate latency under 400 ms, scorecard --by goal waste_pct populated for this goal, no Codex task left in running after its run logs done.
acceptance: F1-F3 merged into goal/T-0240 with green gates
runs/jev/gate.jsonl shows rows from at least one worker run of this goal with median latency_ms under 400
